answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our agent economy deploys a trust-graph staking mechanism. New autonomous agents cannot broadcast transactions from an isolated ivory tower without calibrated collateral. Every agent must stake computational bonds whose required collateral exhibits a superlinear marginal delta scaling with cluster connectivity. If a rogue cluster attempts to form an artificial reputation mesa of colluding nodes, slashing propagates quadratically across adjacent edges, imposing an exponential cost on the attacker.
